connectorUiConfig.title: Lookout Mobile Threat Detection Connector (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Lookout Mobile Threat Detection](https://lookout.com) data connector provides the capability to ingest events related to mobile security risks into Microsoft Sentinel through the Mobile Risk API. Refer to [API documentation](https://esupport.lookout.com/s/article/Mobile-Risk-API-V2-Guide) for more information. This connector helps you examine potential security risks detected in mobile devices.

sampleQueries.description: Lookout Mobile Threat Detection Events - All Activities.

 | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
 | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(2d)

instructionSteps.title: Connect Lookout Mobile Threat Defense connector to Microsoft Sentinel

parameters.content: **Upgrading from an earlier version of this solution?** Updating the solution does not update an existing connector connection or its data collection rule. Disconnect and then reconnect this connector after every solution update to apply the latest polling and field-mapping fixes. Events are fetched from the last 10 days only, so reconnect promptly.
Before connecting to Lookout, ensure the following prerequisites are completed.

#### 1.  **ApiKey** is required for Mobile Threat Detection API. See the [documentation](https://esupport.lookout.com/s/article/Mobile-Risk-API-V2-Guide) to learn more about API. Check all requirements and follow  the [instructions](https://esupport.lookout.com/s/article/Mobile-Risk-API-V2-Guide#authenticatingwiththemobileriskapi) for obtaining credentials.
